page.overview:
What is Dzéwà?

Dzéwà (The White God) is a fictional deity created by Ramsey Campbell for his short story "The Insects from Shaggai".

Dzéwà is a ravenous plant-god that came from Xiclotl to Earth, feared and held in awe by the Shans. It appears as a great white orb hiding an enormous magenta excrescence, an orchid or lamprey mouth with emerald tentacles, tipped with hands emerging from the mass.
